title: Cái này có chứa tôm không?
pronunciation: Cai nay co chua tom khong
summary: For checking shrimp before you order, eat, or accept a dish.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it before tasting the dish. Point to the menu line, sauce, soup, or topping so the answer stays about shrimp.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask while the dish or photo is visible. If this is an allergy, show the allergy note before eating.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có chứa tôm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co chua tom khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Cái này means this item; có chứa asks whether it contains; tôm means shrimp; không makes it a yes/no question.

breakdown.vietnamese: Cái này có chứa tôm không?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Restaurants, street-food stalls, markets, and hotel buffets are the right places to check shrimp clearly.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể làm món này không có nguyên liệu này được không?
phrases.english: Can you make it without this ingredient?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the lam mon nay khong co nguyen lieu nay duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Món ăn nào an toàn nhất cho người bị dị ứng này?

phrases.vietnamese: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà?
phrases.english: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?
phrases.pronunciation: Day la thit lon thit bo hay thit ga

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Shrimp can appear in broths, sauces, fillings, or dried toppings. A yes/no answer matters more than a long explanation.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Peanuts, egg, vegetarian, and peanut-allergy cards cover nearby food-safety checks.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: No-meat, no-ingredient, safe-dish, pork-beef-chicken, and fish-sauce cards help if the answer changes the order.
